potentials.name: Epiphany Bonus
potentials.text: When entering Chaos, obtain 1 random Rare Card with an activated Epiphany.

potentials.name: Basic Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Basic Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Common Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Common Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text: Add the following effect to the Sword Flash card: +30% Damage Amount to Effulgent Blade for 1 turn.

potentials.name: Unique Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Unique Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text: +5% Damage Amount to Heidemarie's Sword Flash and if Heidemarie's Attack is greater than 500, add an additional +5% to the modifier.

potentials.name: Divine Epiphany Adaptation
potentials.text: Increases the chance for a Divine Epiphany to appear by 25%.

potentials.name: Unique Stat Upgrade
potentials.text: If Heidemarie's Attack is greater than 600, +5% Passion Attribute Damage Amount, and for every 20 Attack above 600, add an additional +2% (up to an additional +10%).

manifestEgo.name: Sleeping Memory
manifestEgo.text: +200% Damage Amount to the Effulgent Release card, and the added Damage Amount for each Effulgent Blade in Graveyard becomes +120%.

manifestEgo.name: Awakening Memory
manifestEgo.text: At the start of battle, move the Effulgent Compression card to hand. At the start of the turn, gain 5 Crimson Blade. Crimson Blade: When a Linked card is used manually or Discarded, 120% Extra Attack to the enemy with the highest HP, and when activated, decrease Crimson Blade by 1 (max 8 stacks).

manifestEgo.name: Vivid Memory
manifestEgo.text: +200% Damage Amount to Elysium of Blades and change the +80% Damage Amount (max 20 cards) effect to +100% (max 30 cards) Damage Amount for each card Discarded this battle.

manifestEgo.name: Inner Memory
manifestEgo.text: When manually using or Discarding Heidemarie's Linked cards, gain 1 Effulgent Chain. Effulgent Chain: +5% Damage Amount to Heidemarie (max 10 stacks).

manifestEgo.name: Complete Memory
manifestEgo.text: Increase the level of [Basic Card Upgrade], [Unique Card Upgrade], and [Common Card Upgrade] in Potentials by 3.

manifestEgo.name: Liberated Memory
manifestEgo.text: Change created Effulgent Blade cards to All Attribute Cards. Each time Crimson Blade is activated, +40% Damage Amount to Crimson Blade (max +480%).
